items.name: Yellow Belt Training
items.desc: Two days on the basics of Lean Six Sigma: how to see waste, read a process map and support an improvement team. A good start if you are new to it. Price per seat. Fictional demo offer.

items.name: Green Belt Training
items.desc: Five days to lead your own improvement project with the DMAIC method: measure a process, find causes with data and prove the fix worked. Price per seat. Fictional demo offer.

items.name: Black Belt Training
items.desc: Ten days for people who coach teams and run larger projects: advanced statistics, experiment design and change leadership. Green Belt knowledge helps. Price per seat. Fictional demo offer.

items.name: Coaching Hour
items.desc: One hour with a coach on your own project: sharpen a charter, check your data or plan the next step. Book as many hours as you need. Price per hour. Fictional demo offer.

items.name: Project Sprint
items.desc: A done-with-you improvement project: we work with your team through Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve and Control, and hand over a plan you can run on your own. Pick a time with the team on the booking page. Fictional demo offer.

items.name: Guide: Choose your belt
items.desc: A short read on how Yellow, Green and Black Belt differ, and how to pick the one that fits your role. Unlocked under My purchases.

items.name: Guide: Write a project charter
items.desc: How to write a one-page charter: problem, goal, scope and team, with an example you can adapt. Unlocked under My purchases.
